prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on what you need (spokesperson avatar vs. animated template, generative text→video vs. edit/repurpose, budget, languages, scale). Below are the top choices (as of mid‑2024) and when to pick each one.

Recommendations by use case
- Corporate / spokesperson ads (realistic AI presenters): Synthesia — best overall for polished multilingual avatar spokespersons, strong branding controls and enterprise features.
- Fast social ads with templates and easy editing: Canva or InVideo — huge template libraries, simple editing, great for non‑designers.
- Repurposing long content into short ads: Pictory or Vidyo.ai — automatic clip extraction, captions, and social aspect ratio outputs.
- Deep generative or creative text→video (experimental/highly creative): Runway (Gen‑2) or Pika Labs/Kaiber — better for novel visuals but results can be less predictable.
- Affordable avatar alternatives: HeyGen, Colossyan, Elai.io — similar to Synthesia but often cheaper or with different languages/avatars.
- Full editing + voice cloning / overdub: Descript — excellent for fast edits and natural-sounding overdubs (good if you already have footage).
- Stock-video + automated ad creation: Promo.com — geared specifically at ad creation with licensed footage and ad templates.

Key factors to consider
- Output quality vs. cost: Avatar-based platforms (Synthesia, HeyGen) give high polish but can be pricier; generative systems can create unique visuals but may need manual polishing.
- Languages and accents: Synthesia and HeyGen support many languages; verify the exact language/voice you need.
- Commercial rights: check license/royalty terms for ads — platforms differ on usage rights for paid ads.
- Branding & scale: If you need brand kits, style control, team accounts, and API for automated ad generation, pick enterprise-tier options (Synthesia, Canva Pro/Enterprise).
- Turnaround & ease: Templates + captions + auto-editing = fastest (Canva, InVideo, Pictory).
- Custom actors / IP: If you want a custom virtual actor (your face/actor), confirm whether the platform supports custom avatar creation and any legal/model consent processes.

Quick picks (one-liners)
- Best all-round for polished AI spokesperson ads: Synthesia.
- Best for fast, templated social ads: Canva or InVideo.
- Best for turning webinars/podcasts into short ads: Pictory or Vidyo.ai.
- Best for experimental generative visuals: Runway or Pika Labs.
- Best for easy editing + voice cloning: Descript.

If you tell me: budget, target platforms (TikTok/YouTube/Facebook/LinkedIn), whether you want an AI presenter or animated templates, and how many ads you need per month, I’ll recommend one or two specific services and a sample workflow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
